opening.argument: The speakers promote BitClub Network through recurring Bitcoin returns presented as a reason to participate. They state that “every single person, whether they ever introduce any report or not, is going to continually give you Bitcoin every single day from the mining operation that's in place,” describing passive income even without introducing anyone. They also claim that “we're still making 3 to 5% a month” and that someone could invest a few thousand dollars and “literally make 10, 20 times the money over the next three years.” The offer is further reinforced by recruitment incentives: “if you do sign some people up, you're going to make some great money.” Together, these statements present mining-based recurring returns and additional earnings from bringing others into the network as reasons to join.
